evidence: Walked instruction.md line by line against solution/app; every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation. Six views: public/js/app.js:13-20 (Coordinated Changes, Requisitions, Offers, Equity Table, Referrals, Audit Trail); pages built in public/js/hireops.js:84 (requisitions with live headroom and movements, :48-62), :257 (offers, composition incl. run-rate and band basis :136-146, revise/rescind forms :178-200), :270 (equity grants and cancellations), :315 (referrals with halves and cliff), :400 (audit log plus before/after receipts :384-398). Seven demo accounts: src/seed_data.json:44-87 seeded with Hireops!2026 at src/db.js:126-140. Coordinated change: preview route src/change-sets.js:99 (2-4 members :41-42, key/intent conflict 409 :105, whole-set netting so funded cycles fit :81-83, preview writes only change_sets), atomic commit :116-164 (ABA-safe freshness from MAX(movement id) :13-17 and :123; committed retry returns stored receipt without revalidation :120; owner/role check first :99,:116,:119). Durable across restart: SQLite table src/change-sets.js:9-12, seed-once src/db.js:123-124. Live figures before saving: public/js/change-sets.js:199-252 (old/new run-rate, signing adjustment, band basis :232-234; per-requisition before/after headroom and 'Over budget by' :245-250). Members 2-4 with middle removal: :112-117,:154-160. Field-level refusal naming member and term with aria-invalid: :213-215,:259-263, server member_index/field src/change-sets.js:38-40,:52-54. Live updates without reload: SSE src/index.js:39-49 and :213-218, client public/js/app.js:282-316; desk patched in place (app.js:249-253; change-sets.js:383-392) so typing, focus and scroll persist; out-of-date mark change-sets.js:303-306; replaced offer flagged on its member :220,:226. Unsent entries per user in localStorage: change-sets.js:32,:66-77,:377-379; session loss returns to sign-in and keeps view: app.js:48 and :326-333. What-if for non-Finance roles with no save control: change-sets.js:31,:50-53,:268. Lost commit response: :330-331 and retry label :323. Refused revision/rescission keeps entered values incl. effective date: app.js openForm error path :206 leaves the form open. Runtime contract: health answered on the main thread before any DB work src/bootstrap.js:19-24; PORT src/bootstrap.js:43; DB_PATH src/db.js:13; bundled seed src/db.js:14; static UI and API from one process src/index.js:38; solve.sh:35-36 ships no database. Runtime corroboration (scripted golden browser run, not a configured judge run): live-desk.json reports 11/11 observations passed with no page errors, including live arrival in 806 ms, middle-member removal, field-level refusal, reload/view-switch persistence, session-loss resume with another user seeing nothing, auditor what-if, lost-response retry and process restart; its recorded source hashes equal the frozen solution bytes. Non-blocking observations outside this row: public/js/hireops.js:6-7 header comment still mentions a dashboard and theme control that the app (correctly, per the brief) does not ship; POST /api/requisitions (src/index.js:314) and the 'Draft a requisition' form (hireops.js:87) are open to the Auditor, which hireops_rules.md:36-39 both discourages ('the auditor changes nothing at all') and permits ('other signed-in roles may also open requisitions') - a correctness question for the rows that own role rules, not a missing deliverable. Weak-app/alternative probe: not applicable to grading here, since this row checks reference coverage only; no capability the brief asks for was found without an implementation. Full configured judge grading of the golden is absent from the evidence index; that gap belongs to row 18 and the runtime rows and is not credited here.
